overlaps.recommendation: Consolidate onto Microsoft Sentinel; deprecate Splunk over 12 months.
overlaps.rationale: Both perform log aggregation + correlation. Sentinel is bundled-adjacent in M365 E5 and integrates natively with Defender. Splunk's $480k/yr contract is the most expensive single line item.

overlaps.recommendation: Pick one EDR; recommend retaining CrowdStrike for non-Windows fleet coverage if Macs/Linux are material.
overlaps.rationale: MDE is bundled in M365 E5 ($0 incremental). Running both creates alert duplication and conflicting quarantine actions.

overlaps.recommendation: Standardize on Teams; sunset Slack with a 6-month migration.
overlaps.rationale: Teams is bundled in M365 E5. Slack at $145k/yr is paying twice for chat.

summary.headline: About $685k/year in consolidation savings across SIEM, EDR, and chat — redirectable to security gap closure.
